About this piece
+

Bring the warmth of Mughal-inspired florals into your home with this handcrafted linen cushion cover. Set against a natural earthy-brown base, delicate botanical motifs in deep red, muted green, and warm ochre are thoughtfully arranged across the fabric, creating a look that feels timeless yet beautifully understated.

Each floral motif is hand block printed using traditional Indian techniques, giving the pattern the subtle variations and character that distinguish true artisan-made textiles. Inspired by the stylized flowers found in Mughal art and architecture, the design brings a sense of heritage to a relaxed, contemporary palette.

Style it on a neutral sofa, an accent chair, or layered with solids and complementary prints for an effortlessly collected look.

Pattern. Mughal-Inspired Floral Motifs

Detailing. Contrast Twisted Piping

Closure. Invisible Zipper for a Seamless Finish
